planets.name: TOI-908 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-908 with a 3.18-day year, found in 2023.

text.card: TOI-908 b was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-908. Its orbit and size follow Hawthorn et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
